gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that {@link SparseBloomFilter#processBitMaps} returns {@code false} when the supplied predicate rejects a bitmap word before all words have been consumed.
ADDED i2: Arrange: a small shape (8 bits → 1 long word) used to produce the reference bitmap
ADDED i3: Arrange: a large shape (775 bits → 13 long words) for the filter under test
ADDED i4: The reference filter is empty, so its bitmap array is [0L] (one zero long word)
ADDED i5: Mock predicate: accepts the first long pair, rejects the second
ADDED i6: CountingLongPredicate pairs each incoming long with the next element of referenceBitMap
ADDED i7: Act: process all 13 long words of the empty large filter through the counting predicate
ADDED i8: Assert: the predicate rejected the second long, so processBitMaps must return false
